reviews.title: Ultimate RGB Gaming Mousepad – Halo Infinite Edition Shines!
reviews.comment: I've been using the Razer Goliathus Extended Chroma Gaming Mousepad (Halo Infinite Edition) for several weeks now, and it has completely transformed my gaming setup. This mousepad excels in multiple areas and truly lives up to the Razer reputation. CUSTOMIZABLE RGB LIGHTING: The Chroma RGB lighting is absolutely stunning. The Halo Infinite edition design with customizable colors adds an incredible aesthetic to my desk. Through Razer Synapse, I can sync the lighting with my other peripherals and create immersive lighting effects that react to in-game events. It's a real showpiece that never fails to impress. COMFORT & MATERIAL QUALITY: The soft cloth material is premium quality and feels great under my hand and wrist. Even during marathon gaming sessions lasting 6+ hours, I experience zero discomfort or irritation. The fabric is durable and has maintained its texture perfectly without any fraying or wear, even after weeks of intensive use. GAMING PERFORMANCE: The surface provides the perfect balance between control and speed. Whether I'm making precise headshots in FPS games or executing quick movements in MOBAs, the mousepad responds flawlessly. The extended size (36" x 12") gives me plenty of room for low-sensitivity gaming, and I never run out of space during intense moments. NON-SLIP BASE: The rubber base is exceptional. Once placed, this mousepad doesn't budge an inch, even during the most aggressive mouse movements. This stability is crucial during competitive gaming and gives me complete confidence in my setup. OVERALL EXPERIENCE: For extended gaming sessions, this mousepad is simply outstanding. The combination of comfort, performance, and visual appeal creates an premium experience. The Halo Infinite branding is tastefully done and adds a nice touch for fans of the franchise. PROS: • Stunning, customizable RGB lighting with excellent effects • Premium cloth surface that's smooth and comfortable • Eye-catching Halo Infinite design • Generous extended size perfect for low-DPI gaming • Exceptional comfort during long sessions • Rock-solid non-slip rubber base • Perfect balance of speed and control CONS: • Price point is on the higher side compared to non-RGB alternatives • Requires a USB port for the RGB lighting functionality • The extended size may be too large for smaller desks or compact setups • The lighting cable could be slightly longer for more flexible positioning Despite the minor drawbacks, this is an exceptional gaming mousepad that I would highly recommend to anyone looking to upgrade their setup. The combination of form and function makes it well worth the investment for serious gamers who want both performance and aesthetics.

reviews.title: Big comfy desk mat with LEDs and Halo
reviews.comment: Great addition to the desk set up. A few of the leds around the mat seem like that are slightly different colors than the rest of the border, but It's not very noticable. It's comfortable and the perfect size for mouse and keyboard.
reviews.author: Roland

reviews.title: Does the trick; It lights up pretty
reviews.comment: It's soft and nice to touch; it lights up well with the Razer software. It does its job, and it's cheaper than the unbranded ones. Even if you don't care about Halo, it still adds to any desk setup without being too big, or to small of a mousepad/desk pad. Mice slide right across easily
